notes: 2023 release describes Theken Companies as an Akron-headquartered family of medical device companies, privately held; its Form 5500 shows 55 participants in 2019 and JobsOhio metrics list 33 jobs retained. No headcount stated in the release itself, so the size rests on the 5500 count.

Dollar General 10-K for fiscal 2020 reports about 158,000 employees as of Feb 26, 2021; Dolgencorp LLC is its operating subsidiary and shares the EIN link at the SEC and the Form 5500 sponsor (206,816 participants in 2023). Parent HQ Goodlettsville, TN.

Privately held; JobsOhio 2019 release shows 293 retained at the Sidney plant alone and the Form 5500 for this EIN lists 39,411-48,742 participants (2019-2023); Wikipedia gives about 155,000 worldwide. HQ Minnetonka, MN.

BrewDog USA's 2018 Form 1-K names BrewDog Plc (Ellon, Scotland) as parent and reports 121 full-time and 53 part-time U.S. employees at Dec 31, 2018; the group-wide figure (2,400 per Wikipedia, undated) was not found for 2018-2019. parent: Envelope Mart of Northeast Ohio, Inc. (EM Print Group)
notes: Family-owned wholesale printer founded in 1975 as Envelope Mart of N.E. Ohio, Inc., based at 1540 Lowell St, Elyria; Form 5500 shows 30 participants in 2023 and JobsOhio metrics list 31 retained on an Inclusion Grant. Not related to Envelope Mart USA of Northwood, OH.

Owens & Minor 10-K for 2020 reports about 6,300 U.S. and 12,500 non-U.S. teammates; Owens & Minor Distribution, Inc. is a borrower/subsidiary named in the 10-K exhibits. The SEC registrant (CIK 75252) now appears under the name Accendra Health; HQ Mechanicsville, VA.

ASM International (American Society for Metals) is a 501(c)(3) professional society headquartered at Materials Park, Novelty/Russell Township, OH, per ProPublica; Wikipedia gives 50-100 staff and its Form 5500 shows 63 participants in 2019 (280 in 2015). The 990 PDFs were blocked to automated fetch, so the IRS employee line was not read.

Form 5500 for this EIN is sponsored by Fleck Manufacturing with 5-6 participants (2019, 2023) and JobsOhio metrics list 23 jobs retained plus an Inclusion Grant; Fleck's placeholder site gives a Lima, OH address. No release naming Evanston's owners was found (Google News, JobsOhio sitemap); one of its three grants was a Revitalization Grant, so part of the money may be site-related.

Lubrication Specialties' own site calls it a wholly owned subsidiary of Gold Eagle Company (family-owned, Chicago, founded 1932) with over 60 employees in Mt. Gilead, OH; JobsOhio metrics list 37 retained. No Gold Eagle headcount was found, so the 100-499 bucket is an estimate from the combined operations; the acquisition date was not confirmed but the ownership statement predates the 2023 grant.

Lane Report (Kentucky state release, March 2022): Shelbyville, KY headquarters, 14 facilities in four states, more than 400 team members; Form 5500 shows 286 participants in 2023. Close to the 500 line by the 2024 grant, with 154 retained at the Ohio (Ross County) site.

JobsOhio March 2019 release: Columbus HQ, founded 2011, 30 jobs retained and 80 committed; by the 2020 grant headcount could be near or above 100, so the bucket is a floor. SEC lists a Delaware-incorporated Vantage Point Logistics, Inc. with Ohio HQ (Form D filer); founding in Columbus is inferred from the release's 'since 2011' language.

Unresolved: Google News RSS, EDGAR full-text and company lookup, and guessed company domains turned up nothing on this entity. The listed city White Bear Lake is in Minnesota (the source row says MI); a single $40,000 grant in 2015 and no Form 5500 filing point to a very small firm.

JobsOhio 2018 story: Steiner eOptics is a subsidiary of German Steiner, a member of Beretta Holding; Wikipedia lists Beretta Holding in Luxembourg with 3,388 employees (2021). The recipient's own Form 5500 shows 70 participants in 2019; the Beretta group figure is near the 5000 line and the 2019 figure was not found.
